title: Hatsune Miku — Time To Cheer!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few days after the Sports Festival
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay☆ I'm going to cheer you on with all I've got♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Go, KAITO! You can do it!
Keep it up! KAITOOO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku. You even got the plushies motivated and we had a great practice session.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're very welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Miku, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's the plushies!
How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: We really liked your cheering!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
Yeah! It got me so energized!
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm happy I could help! But the cheering can do much more than just that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What I saw at Emu's Sports Festival was literally out of this world!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It was. And that's why Miku is so into cheering now.

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: What's a Sports Festival...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's umm... A school event with lots of people and...! Students are divided into teams that compete against each other!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Competing? That sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's one where you throw things into a basket, and one where you have to run and jump up and grab a piece of bread with your mouth!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Sports Festival... That sounds exciting!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you want to have a Sports Festival here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can all join and I'll be cheering for you! It's going to be great♪

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Let's have a Sports Festival!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is that okay, KAITO? We can do it, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course! You don't need to ask!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay♪ We have a lot to prepare then too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Indeed. First, we need to get the word out to all the plushies.

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: I can do that!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, there's someone I have to invite too!
I better do it right away!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Who's Miku going to invite?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I can guess...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh no, I can't see anything!
Maybe Emu put her phone in her bag?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Alright, guys! Time for a break!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That's Tsukasa! He sounded far away but Emu has good ears, so she might be able to hear me...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hey! Emuuu!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I hear footsteps! Emuuu!>

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Just a second. I'll take my phone out now!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Pwah! Thanks, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're welcome! Do you want to see the others? We were just taking a break.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<No, it's fine.
I don't want to disturb them.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, silly me! That means you're on break too, Emu...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't worry about it! I'm not even tired or anything! Did you want to hang out together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right! Actually, I dropped in to tell you something♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tell me something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are you ready for it? We're going to have a Sports Festival in SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! That's super duper wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I knew you'd think so! We're doing it for the plushies. They didn't know about them so...!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whaaat?! The Sports Festival is so amazing!
They've really been missing out...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes! My thoughts precisely!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So we're going to have our very own Sports Festival, it's going to be tons of fun for the plushies and it'll be great because I'll get to cheer for everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! They're not exactly the same, but Sports Festivals are a bit like shows too♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, Miku. Is it okay for us to come to your Sports Festival?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Of course! I'm actually here to invite you♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay, thanks! I'll let everyone else know!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Great! There's a lot of work to do, so I should go back now!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We want to make it as awesome as your school's Sports Festival!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Stay tuned!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I will!
